entries.reason: H116 measures candidate circuits by n^k while permitting the actual formula length L_k(n) to be any polynomially related quantity whose exponent may depend on k. Its claimed implication to SAT not in P/poly is therefore invalid: if L_k(n)=n^{k^2}, a hypothetical SAT circuit of size L^3 has size n^{3k^2}, exceeding n^k for every k. The statement does not provide a common input-length parameter under which choosing k above the SAT circuit exponent yields a contradiction.
salvage: H124 fixes formulas at exactly L bits and measures candidate circuits by L^k.
H120's witness-cover condition is retained after rewriting all size accounting in terms of L.
